mechanism: Value Agent hindsight feedback (natural-language explanations) fed back to the Action Agent when re-expanding tree-search nodes
evidence_scope: functions as feedback for the Action Agent, which can leverage this explanation when re-expanding from the parent node
evidence_role: we propose SWE-Search, a multi-agent framework that integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with a self-improvement mechanism to enhance software agents’ performance on repository-level software tasks.
